title: Exact products pass every verification
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and suppose $C'=AB$. Then for every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, one has $C'x=A(Bx)$ in every coordinate.
